# `^FV` – Field Data

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Begin field data; content continues until ^FS. ^FD supplies fixed data, ^FV supplies variable data that can be overridden at print time.

Reference parameters: **data**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 207](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
